taxonomy: National Dex Kanto species; shiny/regional variants map to underlying species where source identifies them. No distinct-form output.

image_preparation.color: sRGB RGB, alpha composited on opaque white
image_preparation.app_import: ImageIO bounded thumbnail (1200px short-side, max2048*2048 decoded area), centered square, CoreGraphics high-quality drawing, CoreML scaleFill
image_preparation.python_approximation: EXIF + white compositing at ingestion, centered square, PIL bilinear fixed-size resize. CoreGraphics interpolation/color parity is pending Apple validation.
image_preparation.resolution: 224 for current candidates and baseline; confirm selected checkpoint config
image_preparation.coreml_input: image, RGB ImageType, fixed batch1; ImageType global scale1/255
image_preparation.normalization_rule: Apply exactly once inside exported graph; do not use averaged per-channel scale

output.name: logits
output.semantics: Unnormalized finite scores in exact supplied labels order; no embedded softmax or temperature

candidate_acceptance: The selected default retains ordinary softmax temperature1, confidence>=.25 and logit margin>=.5; validation-only diagnostic policies are not automatically installed.
promotion: FP32 was explicitly selected as default after source parity and device measurements; independent camera superiority remains unverified.
